units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A close-up at eye level; the camera slides laterally with small amplitude in shallow focus, easing in at the start and settling to a stop at the end. The night sky in close detail: countless round pin-points of pale warm light, all the same tiny size, spread evenly through deep blue-black, the darkness between them clean and even. Across the upper frame a wide lane of the same tiny pin-points sits slightly denser, its brightness almost identical to the sky beside it, its edges soft and open, each speck resolvable on its own. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
